Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 66: January 2007
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #66 shipped to subscribers in December 2006 bearing the cover date of January 2007 (Issue 66). Formatted exclusively for Xbox 360 hardware, it featured native high-definition 360 playable demos and Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) games across third-person sci-fi action, naval strategy, street fighting, and arcade shooters:

Lost Planet: Extreme Condition (third-person sci-fi mech/alien action shooter)
Battlestations: Midway (naval and aerial WWII combat strategy/action)
Def Jam: Icon (hip-hop street brawler / fighting game)
Heavy Weapon (Xbox Live Arcade side-scrolling shoot-'em-up)

The disc also included downloadable Xbox 360 themes, gamerpics, backward-compatibility emulation updates, and 720p/1080i video previews for 2007 blockbusters like Halo 3, Mass Effect, Crackdown, and BioShock, alongside OXM's monthly Top Plays segment.
